_note: Stand-in data for the demo. Session times are minutes relative to when the seed runs, so a session is always on. Every document is labelled stand_in.

venue.name: Venue entrance
venue.rule: Admitted in order of registration. People who state an access need are admitted first, and this priority is shown publicly.

rule_room: Seats go first come, first served at the door. Accessibility seats only go to people who stated that need.

sessions.title: Paved roads: platform engineering at scale
sessions.abstract: How a platform team builds golden paths so hundreds of developers ship to Kubernetes without learning every knob, and how to measure whether the platform helps.

sessions.title: Securing the software supply chain with Sigstore and SLSA
sessions.abstract: Sign every container image, record provenance, and verify it at admission time. A practical path to SLSA level 3 for a small team.

sessions.title: eBPF deep dive: tracing the kernel without patches
sessions.abstract: Attach eBPF programs to kernel and user-space probes to trace latency, syscalls and network flows in production with almost no overhead.

sessions.title: Observability at scale with OpenTelemetry
sessions.abstract: Collecting traces, metrics and logs from thousands of services with OpenTelemetry: sampling, collector pipelines and keeping costs down.

sessions.title: Running LLM inference on Kubernetes GPUs
sessions.abstract: Scheduling GPU workloads, batching requests and autoscaling model servers for large language model inference on Kubernetes.

sessions.title: Prometheus SLOs that people actually read
sessions.abstract: Turning raw Prometheus metrics into service level objectives and error budgets that product teams understand and act on.

sessions.title: Policy as code with Kyverno
sessions.abstract: Write Kubernetes admission policies as YAML, test them in CI, and roll them out without breaking existing workloads.

sessions.title: GitOps with Argo CD: from one cluster to fifty
sessions.abstract: Managing fifty clusters from Git: app-of-apps, progressive sync, drift detection and what broke along the way.

sessions.title: Zero-trust networking with Cilium
sessions.abstract: Identity-aware network policy, transparent encryption and observability of every flow using Cilium and eBPF.

sessions.title: Continuous profiling in production
sessions.abstract: Always-on CPU and memory profiling with low overhead, and how profiles join traces to find the slow line of code.

sessions.title: Event-driven autoscaling with KEDA
sessions.abstract: Scale workloads on queue length, cron schedules or custom metrics, including down to zero, with KEDA.

sessions.title: Vector search on Elasticsearch for RAG
sessions.abstract: Semantic search, hybrid ranking and chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation with Elasticsearch.

sessions.title: Chaos engineering game day
sessions.abstract: Run a game day: break things on purpose in a safe way, practise incident response, and learn where your system is fragile.

sessions.title: Accessible developer portals with Backstage
sessions.abstract: Building a Backstage developer portal that works with a screen reader and a keyboard, and why accessibility is part of developer experience.
